structured.answer: Fairly sure: the ones worth looking into are a קרן כספית for the safe part, a חשבון ניירות ערך at my bank to buy an S&P 500 tracking fund, and checking my קרן השתלמות. But the page only lists types; it doesn't tell me which to pick, what the fees are or what to do first.

stuck.why: I thought it was a pension thing for old people, but the card says 'אפשר למשוך בכל עת'. Confusing.
Lots of אג"ח and index cards that look alike, with no hint which one is for me.
No fees, no amounts and no 'start here' step for my 30,000 ₪.

unsure_meaning: MSCI AC World vs MSCI World
Whether קרן מחקה and the 'קרן שעוקבת אחריו' are the same thing
not_found: A recommendation or 'what to do first' step
Which bank or investment house to use
How a monthly few hundred shekels fits in

findings.what: Just a catalogue of about 25 similar cards with no guidance on which suits someone starting with 30,000 ₪
Jargon like מק"מ and צמודה appears without explanation, and מק"מ appears twice
Opening cards (עו"ש, פיקדון, תכנית חיסכון) were cut off between the first and second screens
MSCI and other cards were cut off between the third and fourth screens
The last two screens are almost identical, so it feels like the page ends abruptly
